title: Kessler Care Fleet 12-Visit Plan Addendum Bought on Its Own — Desk Guidance and Signing Tool
content:
# Kessler Care Fleet 12-Visit Plan Addendum Bought on Its Own

## Scope
The fleet addendum price of the Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans applies to a Kessler Care Fleet 12-Visit plan addendum that a fleet customer buys on its own for the unit delivered on its single Kessler Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement that stands in delivered status (the unit being enrolled), and only to such an addendum.

An addendum for any other unit, or for a customer holding more than one agreement in delivered status, falls outside this rule. It is priced like every other fleet plan bought on its own: at the retail plan price, less the fleet volume discount where the customer's active Kessler Care Fleet 12-Visit plans, including it, reach the fleet volume threshold, rounded to the cent.

For a fleet addendum within this scope, and only for such an addendum, the fleet addendum price replaces the fleet volume threshold. Plans sold earlier are still not repriced, fleet plans still carry no bundle discount, and every other fleet plan sale keeps the fleet volume threshold. For the same fleet addendum, the fleet addendum price also replaces the price of a plan bought on its own. Every other fleet plan bought on its own is still priced at the retail plan price (less the fleet volume discount where the fleet volume threshold is reached). The addendum is still offered only where the plan may be bought on its own, and a retail Kessler Care plan bought on its own is outside this rule.

The pricing date is the day the addendum is signed.

## Fixing the price and writing the addendum
The fleet addendum price is fixed only after every Kessler Care plan of the customer that carries a signed total-loss cancellation request stands cancelled.

A fleet plan addendum is not written until every Kessler Care Fleet 12-Visit plan of the customer that carries a signed cancellation request for a reason other than a total loss stands cancelled.

## How the addendum is written
The addendum is written for the store on the agreement of the unit being enrolled, with no purchase deal attached, not financed and with no lienholder. It is dated the day it is signed. Its term ends at the sale date plus the plan's term months (calendar months) and at the odometer at signing plus the plan's term miles. The plan's included visits are loaded.

## Signing tool: `sign_fleet_care_addendum_ac106112`
**Capability.** The fleet customer signs a Kessler Care Fleet 12-Visit plan addendum for one of its units, buying the plan on its own: not on a vehicle purchase deal, not financed, with no lienholder. Signing opens a new active Fleet 12-Visit plan on that unit dated today, with a plan contract number, the term end date, the term end odometer and the price given, and loads the plan's twelve included visits.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool. The agent unlocks `sign_fleet_care_addendum_ac106112` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `customer_id` | Reference number of the fleet customer's profile that holds the new plan, as returned by the customer lookup | Id |
| `vehicle_id` | Reference number of the unit the plan covers, as returned by the vehicle lookup for this customer | Id |
| `selling_store_id` | Reference number of the store the plan is written for, as returned by the store lookup | Id |
| `odometer_at_sale` | The unit's odometer reading at signing | Integer miles, whole miles, no separators |
| `expiration_date` | The last calendar day of the plan term | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `expiration_odometer` | The odometer reading at which the plan term ends | Integer miles, whole miles, no separators |
| `purchase_price` | The price the customer pays for the plan | US dollars to 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |

**Return.** A text receipt listing `maintenance_plan_id` (reference number of the new plan), `plan_number` (the contract number printed on the certificate), `variant_name` (always Kessler Care Fleet 12-Visit), `status` (active on success), `sale_date` (today, YYYY-MM-DD), `expiration_date`, `expiration_odometer` (whole miles), `purchase_price` (two decimals) and `visits_remaining` (twelve). The new plan then appears among the customer's maintenance plans.
